UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private owner profile document acting as the Master Gate root for a user's persisted server configurations.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: Verified Google account email of the owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

GeminiAccountVault.title: GeminiAccountVault
GeminiAccountVault.description: Persisted Gemini API account entry owned privately by the authenticated user and automatically hydrated onto the server.

id.description: Unique account identifier matching the document ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

label.description: Human-readable name for the Gemini API account.

apiKey.description: Gemini API key synced privately to the server Gemini pool.

enabled.description: Whether this API account is active in the Gemini pool.

isChairman.description: Whether this API account is currently designated as the Gemini Chairman.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was last modified.

GeminiPoolSettings.title: GeminiPoolSettings
GeminiPoolSettings.description: Owner-specific Gemini pool governance settings (Chairman ID and default system key state).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

chairmanAccountId.description: Account ID currently selected as Gemini Chairman.

envDefaultEnabled.description: Whether the built-in server GEMINI_API_KEY is enabled.

envDefaultLabel.description: Display label for the built-in system Gemini account.

envDefaultNote.description: Optional note for the built-in system Gemini account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when pool settings were first saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when pool settings were last modified.

/users/{userId}.description: Private owner root profile document; acts as Master Gate for user subcollections.

/users/{userId}/geminiAccounts/{accountI.description: Owner-private vault of persisted Gemini API accounts synchronized to the backend server pool.
